proposed_widenings.name: PassiveMechanics.choice_of_grants
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is one species trait whose mechanics are chosen from a closed build-time lineage table, and each lineage carries a different grant bundle. The current passive surface can only express one fixed grants list.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

proposed_widenings.name: level_gated_passive_grant
proposed_widenings.justification: The same chosen lineage adds further grants at character levels 3 and 5. Current passive grants have no character-level threshold wrapper, so encoding them as always-on would be false.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.choice_from_spell_list_with_rest_swap
proposed_widenings.justification: High Elf does not grant one fixed cantrip. It grants one Wizard cantrip and allows replacing it after each Long Rest. The current spell-access surface requires a fixed spellId and has no rest-based replacement path.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Long Rest, you can replace that cantrip with a different cantrip from the Wizard spell list.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellcasting_ability_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait chooses one spellcasting ability when the lineage is selected, then uses that ability for all spells cast through the trait. Current grant_spell_access supports DC override, but not a build-time ability-choice source for the grant.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

notes: Did not author a placeholder record. Individual sub-benefits map to existing atoms like grant_sense, modify_speed, and grant_spell_access, but the unit as written needs build-time lineage selection plus character-level-gated grants and High Elf's long-rest cantrip replacement.
